_doc: Image asset slots. An asset renders only if the file exists under src/ AND authorised is true (and, where a caption is used, caption_approved is true). Otherwise its slot renders nothing, or the stated fallback; no 'image pending' box is ever shown. Missing assets are reported by the build as optional and never block publication.

logo.fallback: interim mark (assets/img/mark.svg) with the text wordmark
logo.note: Official logo from the brand guidelines (Studio P+P, 2021). Supply as SVG; replace the file and set authorised to true.

softgel-render.alt: Computer-generated render of an NWPT-SM32300 softgel capsule
softgel-render.caption: NWPT-SM32300 300 mg oral softgel. Computer-generated render supplied by NWPharmaTech; not to scale. Investigational medicine.

micelle-render.alt: Illustration of a lipid formulation dispersing into small droplets in water
micelle-render.caption: Illustration of self-emulsification: the capsule contents disperse into very small droplets in water. Schematic; not to scale, and not an image of the body.
